title: [Autour de La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois, pages 1 à 67] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (cf. pp. 61-63 of these drafts): K ⊂ L are fields of finite type over Q. E_L^{\bar L} = Gal(\bar L/L) maps onto E_K^{\bar K} = Gal(\bar K/K). Grothendieck studies sections, and germs of sections (sections over open subgroups of E_K), of E_L → E_K.

The known supply of sections: take a valuation ring V of L containing K, i.e. a point of the Zariski-Riemann 'variety' of L/K, whose residue field is finite (algebraic) over K; 'points of dimension 0'. Let N_V ⊃ I_V be its decomposition and inertia groups in E_L. A section of N_V → E_K gives a section of E_L → E_K, and that section normalizes I_V.

Previous page: for a subextension L_1 ⊂ L of transcendence degree 1 over K, compose with E_L → E_{L_1}. This gives sections of E_{L_1} over E_K. The question is whether one gets more than those attached to the places of the curve L_1/K.

This page answers no, at least for sections coming from such V:
- Put V_1 = V ∩ L_1. It is a valuation ring of L_1.
- Its residue field embeds in that of V, so it is finite over K whenever V's is.
- Hence V_1 ≠ L_1, since L_1 itself is transcendental over K.
- So V_1 is a genuine place of the function field L_1 of a curve over K.

By functoriality, with compatible choices of extensions to \bar L ⊃ \bar L_1, the map E_L → E_{L_1} sends N_V into N_{V_1} and I_V into I_{V_1}. Therefore the image of a section of N_V over E_K normalizes I_{V_1}.

Its restriction to E_K^0 centralizes I_{V_1}. Here E_K^0 is apparently the subgroup Γ^0 of p. 63 with Centr_Γ(Γ^0) = 1, most plausibly Gal(\bar K/K(μ_∞)). This works because I_{V_1} ≅ \hat Z(1) (characteristic 0, discrete rank-1 place), on which N_{V_1} acts through the cyclotomic character.

Grothendieck then states a Conjecture (continued p. 63). Let K ⊂ L be of finite type over Q.
- (a) Every section, or germ of section, of E_L → E_K normalizes some I_V. Here V is a valuation ring of L/K containing K with residue field algebraic over K, and V is uniquely determined by this condition. In fact the section comes from a section of N_V over E_K.
- (b) (p. 63) A comparison with sections of π_1 of an 'elementary' model U of L/K. For a K-rational point x of U, he conjectures (E_L^{\bar L})^{Γ^0} = 1, equivalent to (π^{\bar L}_{L/K})^{Γ^0} = 1.

This is the birational section conjecture in arbitrary relative dimension, phrased via dimension-0 points of the Zariski-Riemann space (valuations of any rank). He also sketches a dévissage to transcendence degree 1 via subfields L_1.
errors: The argument only shows that sections ALREADY coming from some N_V push forward to sections attached to places of L_1. It does not show that an arbitrary section of E_{L_1} over E_K obtained from E_L is of this type. That stronger claim is the content of the conjecture, not a proof.

The statement 'E_K^0 centralise I_{V_1}' is correct only if E_K^0 lies in the kernel of the cyclotomic character, since I_{V_1} ≅ \hat Z(1) as a Galois module. If E_K^0 denoted an arbitrary open subgroup, the claim would be false. The intended meaning (Γ^0 as on p. 63) seems to be the kernel of the cyclotomic character.

Compatibility of the inclusions N_V → N_{V_1} and I_V → I_{V_1} requires choosing the extension of V_1 to \bar L_1 as the restriction of the chosen extension of V to \bar L. This is implicit ('fonctorialités suffisamment évidentes').

ideas.what: Sections of Gal(L) → Gal(K) attached to valuations of L/K with residue field algebraic over K (dimension-0 points of the Zariski-Riemann space), via sections of decomposition groups.
ideas.modern_name: Packets of sections from decomposition groups / birational section conjecture
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (letter to Faltings 1983); developed by Koenigsmann, Pop, Stix
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings (1983), birational version for curves; the higher-dimensional valuation-theoretic form is unsure

ideas.what: Restriction of a valuation V of L/K with algebraic residue field to a transcendence-degree-1 subfield L_1 gives a nontrivial place of L_1. Functoriality N_V → N_{V_1}, I_V → I_{V_1}.
ideas.modern_name: Functoriality of decomposition/inertia groups under field restriction

ideas.what: Conjecture (a): every (germ of) section of E_L → E_K for L/K finitely generated over Q normalizes the inertia group of a unique valuation V of L/K with residue field algebraic over K, and comes from a section of N_V.
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck; Koenigsmann (p-adic birational, 2005), Pop (birational p-adic SC for curves, 2010); discussed by Stix
ideas.where_published: Possibly in the 'Longue Marche' manuscript (Malgoire transcription); unsure

ideas.what: Uniqueness of V from the section (inertia groups of distinct valuations are not normalized by a common section).
ideas.modern_name: Separatedness / local theory of decomposition groups (Pop's local theory)

missed.claim: Grothendieck formulates the birational section conjecture for function fields of ARBITRARY transcendence degree over a finitely generated K. Points correspond to valuations of any rank with residue field algebraic over K (dimension-0 points of Zariski-Riemann space), with uniqueness, and a germ version over open subgroups. He suggests a reduction to transcendence degree 1 via subfields L_1, using V ↦ V ∩ L_1.
missed.quote: Toute section de E_L sur E_K (ou germe de tel ...) normalise un I_V associé à un anneau de valuation V de L sur K contenant K, à corps résiduel algébrique et V est uniquement [déterminé par] cette condition
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Most literature treats the birational section conjecture for curves (rank-1 places). A precise higher-dimensional valuation-theoretic formulation, with a dévissage strategy via transcendence-degree-1 subfields, is a natural framework for current work. However, similar formulations exist in Pop/Stix, so novelty is modest.

deep.surprise_reason: The page gives an early, careful higher-dimensional formulation of the birational section conjecture via Zariski-Riemann dimension-0 points, including the germ variant and uniqueness. It also gives a compatibility check with transcendence-degree-1 subfields. The general idea is credited to Grothendieck and was later developed by others, so this is a notable detail but not a missed result.
transcription_corrections: 'On, par des fonctorialités' should read 'Or, par des fonctorialités'.
'Soient K, L des cat.[?] de type fini de Q' should almost certainly read 'des corps de type fini sur Q'.
'associé à une valuation[?] de valuation V' should read 'associé à un anneau de valuation V'.
'à corps résiduel algébrique [-sur-]': the residue field is algebraic (over K), and the text continues 'et V est uniquement [déterminé par] cette condition' (p. 63).
Last line of the first paragraph: 'et sa restriction à E_K^0 centralise I_{V_1}'.
Left margin note is only partially legible: roughly 'Il faut voir si par le corps des fonctions V_1 ... de dim L_1 ... grand fait ...'; its reading is uncertain.
